svg.text: Kokeba — AI-Agent Publishing Platform · End-to-End Architecture & Data Flow
Country-agnostic engine: swap a Country Pack + Age-Range Pack to launch any market · first release: Ethiopia, ages 0–3 board books
▸ Age-Range Pack: BISAC age, words, pages
swap these → new country / age band;
① Market-Intelligence Agent (the “what sells fast” engine)
ingests licensed data → ranked brief · niche score · keyword / cover / price signals
compliant data only — NO direct Amazon scraping
plans each book · sequences every agent · enforces guardrails
routes work · reads + writes the tracker
1 row per book: status · files · keywords · ISBN · sales
COPPA · safety (CPSIA) · originality — blocks on fail
⑦ Marketing Agent Team (coordinated by the Orchestrator, governed by the Control Plane)
connects to: Google/Meta Ads APIs · Email MCP (Klaviyo/HubSpot) · Social platforms · Airtable/Notion
CONTROL PLANE — applies to every agent
hard budget caps · approval gates · brand-rules file · COPPA / ads no-go (target adults only, no kids’ data) · full logging · anomaly alerts · kill switch
